SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi
3. Practise Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi at school and at home

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: KUSOMA 3.2.1 KUSOMA KWA KINA USHAIRI USHAIRI
This lesson teaches Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi for Grade 9 KISWAHILI.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Describe Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Underline the key ideas about Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi above.
2. Explain Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.
